facts.fact: Parliamentary committee chair Fatuma Toufiq, speaking for the Speaker at an AI training for MPs in Dodoma, said Tanzania has no policy or law on how AI is to be run and supervised so that its negative uses are dealt with.

TZA.note: Says only that Tanzania has begun using AI, with no government body or system named.

facts.fact: Parliamentary committee chair Fatuma Toufiq said at an MPs' AI training in Dodoma that Tanzania has no AI policy yet, and MPs called for one.

TZA.note: No model, dataset or AI computing stated.
